title: docs(spec): postureStampsOrganization docblock names the open stampers
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi95tVgzfxNpUQDVe92GxUNjY)_

Fixes #28761

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改 `packages/spec/src/security/tenancy-posture.ts` 中 `postureStampsOrganization` 上方的注释，外加一条 `@objectstack/spec` patch changeset；不改任何代码。
- 为什么改：旧注释说"打 organization_id 的是企业版 organizations 运行时，不是开源引擎"，与代码相反：开源引擎在写入时把记录落到当前组织，SQL 驱动补上缺省的 organization_id。保留真实的一半：启用多组织姿态仍需企业版运行时。
- 风险与回滚：零运行时风险（仅注释，随 `dist` 的 `.d.ts` 发布）；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/security/tenancy-posture.ts` 的 `postureStampsOrganization` 文档块。
- 两分钟验证：`git diff origin/main...HEAD -- packages/spec/src/security/tenancy-posture.ts`，预期只见注释行变动、无一行代码变化。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Comments only, plus a `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/spec` (the JSDoc ships in the built declaration chunk, so the published bytes change).

The `postureStampsOrganization` docblock said "The STAMPER, however, is the enterprise `@objectstack/organizations` runtime, not the open engine … the open engine only VALIDATES supplied values". It now says:

- **The stamping is open code** (ADR-0105 D5). The engine lands an insert in the caller's active organization in every posture (`ObjectQL#driverWriteTarget`, body in `packages/objectql/src/engine-driver-options.ts`), and the SQL driver fills an absent `organization_id` from it (`SqlDriver#injectTenantOnInsert`, `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts`).
- **An explicit value is never overwritten.** Where `@objectstack/plugin-security` installs the wall on the write, it holds that value to the Layer 0 verdict (the `wallJudgesOrganization` seam documented in `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`).
- **The enterprise runtime fills an absent value too**, in its write middleware (the `callerKeySets` docblock in `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` names it), but it is not the only stamper.
- **Kept, the true half:** activating a walled posture needs that runtime (ADR-0105 D12). The wording follows #28703's merged verify docblock (#28760).

## Tests

No behaviour changes, so no test was added or changed.

- Published-surface check after the build: the new docblock (with "but it is not the only stamper") is in `packages/spec/dist/queue.zod-IH5GXQGp.d.ts` / `.d.mts`, directly above `declare function postureStampsOrganization`; "not the open engine" has 0 matches in `dist/security/index.d.ts`. `files` includes `dist`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Where the JSDoc ships.** The card and triage said `dist/security/index.d.ts`. After the build the declaration lives in a shared chunk (`dist/queue.zod-IH5GXQGp.d.ts`) that the security entry re-exports. It still ships, so the changeset level (`patch`) holds.
- **No consumers.** `postureStampsOrganization` has no caller in this repo (grep at 1617b7fb); only `api-surface/security.json` and `export-origins/security.json` name it, and those record names only, so they did not move.
